existing_gate: Independent factor replays truncated at a construction endpoint; strength already reduced before initial equilibration.

source_findings.finding: MaterialSet Preserve retains material states but prepare_transition_mode validates them against the replacement model.
validate_state rejects normalized yield exceedance; a reduced envelope can reject an originally admissible stressed state before return mapping.

inference: Appending ordinary MaterialSet is not a general implementation of weakening a loaded equilibrium. Existing input and checkpoint validators must remain strict.
proposed_next_implementation: Create and seal an unreduced, accepted endpoint with exact active geometry, loads, displacement/reference, material/contact/member histories and fixed accepted pore pressure.

Use an explicitly scoped parameter-continuation update: validate committed stress/history with the accepted old parameters; return-map the new-strength trial without resetting cumulative plastic history; commit new parameters and history together only at accepted global equilibrium.
Every factor starts from the same immutable unreduced origin. No reuse of another factor’s weakened state; no relabelling input hashes or changing checkpoint identity to bypass verification.

Keep numerical incompleteness, inadmissible input, constitutive failure, verified equilibrium and independently supported mechanism evidence separate. A Newton or linear-solver failure alone cannot update the physical upper bracket.
Initial scope must explicitly reject unsupported MCC/IDH reduction and any unsupported member/contact/fluid reduction policy.
required_tests: Material point weakening at zero total strain with an independent active-set solution; preserve accumulated plastic strain and plastic work.
F=1 exact same origin and history; forward/reverse factor order independence; every rejected parameter/load step restores state and parameters byte-exactly.
Force-controlled and displacement-controlled one-element/column solutions, nonassociated flow, Rankine/edge/apex transitions, selected/unselected material IDs.
Frozen water-pressure/load field and construction origin; then independent3D and fixed2D slope comparisons with separate mesh/depth/increment studies.
Typed Fs interval/Fs_req gates accept only qualified physical evidence; injected numerical errors leave the interval unknown.

primary_references.facts: Each trial restores a saved initial state; the documented procedure uses time-marching motion/equilibrium evidence and fixed flow during strength reduction.
primary_references.fem_inference: The time-marching response-block constants do not supply a physical upper-bracket classifier for this static Newton FEM.
